notes.title: Join our Discord for a Chance to Win a Steam Key on Launch
notes.content:
Join our Discord for a Chance to  Win a Steam Key! 🎁

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43549363/ed08ddcbca6099cfb591b98d36332203a3394eea.png

Join our Discord community and be the first to play Peaceful Lands! As a member of our community, you will have the opportunity to give feedback directly to the developer and help shape the game's future. Don't miss your chance to win a free game key for Peaceful Lands on launch day.
Join now and be a part of this exclusive group!
